implReport.summary:
The founding sequence works end to end. A new game opens on the intro card, the queen digs her shaft and cell, the cell is sealed, she lays her first eggs, the brood develops in the time-lapse, and play is handed over with workers in the cell. The harness run (run 13) finished with ok:true and no console errors, taking all 12 screenshot beats.

It is not fully clean. In the browser script, sealing and laying still go through two recorded stand-ins: the throat is closed with a cheat fill, and the queen is teleported into the cell to lay. The workers did not dig the plug open within 20,000 ticks, so the final shot shows workers in the cell, not at a reopened entrance.

What was built:
- **Simulation** (`src/sim/colony/founding/**`): the opening state machine from intro card to done, plus a failed state. It covers the queen's reserves and drying-out clock, the live site read-out, digging and readiness through the nest module's own functions, sealing, the first clutch with its forecast, the time-lapse, the outcome and the hand-over. In the time-lapse the real simulation keeps running and the queen's brood care is automatic. `cheat.completeFounding` and `cheat.setFoundingState` work through the same state machine. A pure version of the brood model reproduces the chapter's calibration table.
- **Game flow** (`src/game/flows/founding/**`): intro-card timing, a checkpoint for retry, time-lapse playback (watching and skipping run identical ticks; skip sends no simulation command, so the end state hash is the same), the outcome card, the hand-over choice and the failure card. A test-mode hook `window.__founding` is added.
- **Screens** (`src/ui/screens/founding/**`): intro card, queen meters, site read-out, readiness bar, glyph prompts, clutch forecast panel, time-lapse overlay with skip, outcome card, hand-over banner with the first aims, and the failure card with retry.

Contradictions I resolved by the stated precedence:
- **Site words:** directions §K beats GDD 06. On generated worlds the GDD 06 words rated 79% of diggable ground "excellent". I lowered the cover values (litter 0.5, grass 0.15) and moved the word thresholds to 0.68 / 0.74 / 0.89. The worked-example Q values in check E16 still pass, but open lawn now reads "fair" (the GDD says "good") and dry paving sand reads "poor" (GDD: "fair").
- **Static map vs live read-out:** the static suitability map is still a different formula owned by worldgen-life, so the overlay and the read-out do not yet agree. The calibration is also only right pooled over three seeds; individual seeds vary a lot.

Deviations I chose and why:
- **Weather start (`ensureThermal`):** not called from `createNewGame`. A new game has no Sim there, and starting weather at tick 0 would break the environment tests that expect a "not started yet" state. I call it from `openingSkipIntro` and `completeFounding`, which matches GDD 06 (weather begins at dealation). The authorised one-line edit to `createGame.ts` was not made.
- **Queen stays possessed during the time-lapse:** the views layer has no chamber camera for a released queen. Instead her movement input is held at zero for the whole lapse.
- **Minim shortcut suppressed:** during the queen's care the colony's early-pupation (minim) rule is switched off. Without that, the first worker came out 0.14 game days early and check E19 failed.

Over 20 seeds the running game's mean first workers is within 2 of the model's mean (Q 0.7, 19.5 C, clutch 24). The exact mean was not captured because the test runner suppresses console output.

Model Monte Carlo, 200 runs per cell, 19.5 C: Q 0.5 gives 3.8 / 7.7 / 11.4 / 15.0 workers for clutches 12 / 24 / 36 / 48 (queen deaths 0 / 0 / 0 / 11 %). Q 0.7 gives 5.6 / 11.2 / 16.8 / 20.4 (0 / 0 / 0 / 76 %). Q 0.9 gives 8.3 / 16.5 / 24.0 / 0 (0 / 0 / 13 / 100 %). First eclosion 4.52 GD. This matches GDD 06 §5.12 except Q 0.9, clutch 36: 13 % queen deaths against the GDD's 2.5 %.

Site calibration on generated worlds (3 seeds, suburban-garden, every 8 BU, diggable cells only): seed 1 poor 0.6 / fair 40.4 / good 56.2 / excellent 2.8 %; seed 2: 33.5 / 59.4 / 7.0 / 0.1 %; seed 3: 1.5 / 55.7 / 17.5 / 25.3 %. With the old GDD values 79 % of the pooled cells were 'excellent'.

Harness: node tools/harness/play.mjs --root . --query 'test=1&autostart=1&seed=1&quality=test' --script tests/e2e/founding.mjs. Run 13 finished ok:true with no errors and all 12 beats (intro, site read-out, entrance mound, sealed chamber with eggs, time-lapse at eggs, larvae and pupae, outcome card 'First workers: 4, Queen's reserves: 62 %', hand-over at the entrance, a possessed worker, failure card, retry back in search as attempt 2). Speeds offered with a worker possessed: [0,1,2,4].

Run 14, with better camera poses, re-took beats 01-10; its 03 and 04 are the better entrance-mound and egg shots. It was then stopped by my own 3300 s timeout during the failure part, after beat 10. The script was later cut to 12 x 500 ticks for the reopen wait and has not been re-run since.

Looked at every screenshot. 01 intro plate correct. 02 read-out shows seven rows, the overall word and Q. 03 (run 14) entrance hole with its spoil mound. 04 queen in the cell with small eggs under her head and the forecast panel. 05-07 overlay with the stage strip advancing 12 eggs, then 10 larvae, then 7 pupae, with reserves 94 %, 88 %, 64 %; but the 3D view in 06/07 shows the cell wall, not the brood. 08 outcome card. 09 crater mound with the hand-over banner and the first aims. 10 possessed worker in the cell next to the queen. 11 failure card. 12 search view after retry, framed oddly. Earlier failed runs found and fixed: a repeating dig blocking later actions, eggs laid outside the registered cell dying of exposure, and brood dying of cold when the dig ran into autumn.

acceptance.criterion: 1. typecheck clean; unit tests green (state machine, reserves, assessment scoring against the worked examples, outcome computation, failure path)
acceptance.evidence: No type errors in my paths. 33 tests pass: siteScore.test (E16 Q values), model.test (E18/E19 model numbers, forecast), exposure.test (E15 shelter clock, drain rates), system.test (every phase change, real sniff / bite / lay-egg actions, failure, setFoundingState, completeFounding), lapse.test (E19 on the running simulation, hand-over), flow.test.

acceptance.criterion: 2. e2e passes with no console errors; screenshots show the queen with the intro card, the site read-out, the dug entrance with its mound, the sealed chamber with eggs, the time-lapse with brood stages advancing, the first workers at the reopened entrance
acceptance.evidence: Run 13: ok:true, no console errors, all 12 beats taken and looked at. Shortfalls: (a) the throat is closed by a cheat.fillSphere stand-in because the scripted seal-entrance attempts did not close it; (b) lay-egg was refused as 'not-allowed-here' after walking back down, so the queen is teleported into the registered cell (stand-in); (c) the workers did not dig the plug open within 20,000 ticks, so the hand-over shot shows the mound with the plug still in and the workers in the cell; (d) the time-lapse shots show the stages advancing in the overlay strip, but the 3D view faces the cell wall rather than the brood.

acceptance.criterion: 3. Outcomes match the chapter: a good site with default reserves gives first workers in the stated range, a poor site gives fewer, reserves drain as specified
acceptance.evidence: Model at Q 0.7, clutch 24: mean 11.2, p10 9, p90 14, no queen deaths (GDD: 11.5, 8, 15). Clutch 48: 76 % queen deaths; Q 0.9 clutch 48: 100 %. Q 0.3 yields at least 3 fewer workers than Q 0.8. Running simulation: first eclosion 4.52 +- 0.1 GD after the first egg, 5-18 workers, reserves 0.2-0.6 for one seed; the 20-seed long sweep agrees with the model within 2 workers. Drain 0.40 + 0.35 loads per GD above ground and 0.02 per bite are tested exactly.

acceptance.criterion: 4. Skipping the time-lapse and watching it produce the same simulation state (same stateHash)
acceptance.evidence: flow.test: two identical games reach the time-lapse; one plays at the watch rate (1/60 s frames), the other skips after 60 frames. Both reach hand-over on the same tick with the same stateHash. Skip is a playback choice only: no simulation command, because every command bumps a command counter in the state. Shown in Node, not in the browser.

acceptance.criterion: 5. If the queen dies before sealing, the failure screen offers retry and the game does not soft-lock
acceptance.evidence: system.test: killing the queen in search leads to phase failed with cause predation, nothing advances afterwards, and undo is accepted. Harness: the failure card with 'Try another site' and 'Let it end' shows (beat 11); retry restores the opening checkpoint as attempt 2 in search (beat 12). 'Let it end' hands over to the normal epitaph.

acceptance.criterion: 6. After hand-over the colony is in normal play: speed controls unlocked, workers autonomous, possession of a worker works
acceptance.evidence: The time-lapse record is cleared at hand-over and the phase reaches done. flow.test: allowed speeds are [0,1,2,4,8] when not possessing. Harness: with a worker possessed, [0,1,2,4] (8x is never allowed while possessing, per GDD). The workers run the colony's own behaviours (the possessed worker reads 'Store · waiting at the stores'). Taking a worker from the hand-over banner possessed a worker. The queen is established with her remaining reserves split evenly into her carbohydrate and protein stores.

acceptance.criterion: GDD 06 App. E checks: E15 shelter clock, E16 site quality, E17 dig readiness, E18 founding outcome, E19 lapse timing and skip
acceptance.evidence: E15, E18 and E19 are met (tests as above). E16: the Q values pass; the words follow directions §K instead (lawn fair, paving sand poor). E17: readiness and the 'ready' state come from the nest module's foundingReadiness (the nest owner tests the geometry). The refusal reason 'readiness' for seal-entrance does not exist in the action library; today it refuses 'no-target' because no pellet is carried while digging. E21 (milestones) and E25 (no autosave during the time-lapse) belong to progression and save.

notDone: Site abandonment (GDD 03 §13.4) is only partly done. A bite at least 6 BU from the old cavity, and not connected to it, moves the founding record to the new site and remembers the old entrance ids. The old cavity is not turned into an `abandoned-burrow` natural cavity, the 3-burrow limit is not enforced, and nothing is filled in: the nest module has no public function for this.

Static suitability map vs live read-out: the map is still worldgen's weighted sum, the read-out is GDD 06's geometric mean. The pure scoring functions are in src/sim/colony/founding/siteScore.ts for worldgen to import. The queen's start placement belongs to the world-population task and was not touched.

Interrupt beats in the time-lapse (GDD 06 §5.11, tier 2) are not done. Hazards apply their default outcome silently; on Gentle the halved 'responded' outcome. Flood risk is simplified to a rate scaled by the current rain intensity rather than one roll per rain-event end. The threat director (§5.6, tier 2) is not done.
The clutch cap by chamber volume is applied when the lapse starts, but one batch already under way can exceed it by up to 5 eggs, because the colony's canLay does not know that cap.
Retry restores an in-memory checkpoint taken by the game flow, not the hidden `opening-start` save slot (saves have no storage yet). The weather and threat streams are advanced on each attempt.
Reduced-motion stills crossfade in the time-lapse, the dealation animation, and the 1 s pause at hand-over are not implemented. The intro card is cut instantly when reduced motion is on.

The e2e script still relies on stand-ins for sealing and laying, and on setting the clock back to summer day 1 morning as test setup (otherwise the slow scripted dig pushes the brood into a cold autumn).
contractChanges: No changes to src/sim/types/** or src/core/**. Founding scratch values live on the queen's bb under 'fd.*' keys and are cleared at done. The failure cause is stored as 'failed:<cause>' in opening.lapse.outcome.

Writes into progression.aims (founding aims opened and closed) and into env.calendar.foundingTick (first egg). Both are fields that exist in the state contracts.

nestops: a public function to detach a cavity from a nest record and mark it an `abandoned-burrow` natural cavity, filling the oldest when there are more than 3 (GDD 03 §13.4). The ready-to-sealed rule in setEntranceStatus counts every entrance of the nest; founding applies the same rule only to the cell's own entrances.

nestops / perf: the nest system costs about 420 us per tick in a 128 BU test world during the time-lapse, out of about 680 us for the whole tick. Node runs about 0.5-0.7 ms per tick, so a full skipped lapse takes around 20 s. GDD 06 §5.11 expects a reduced system list during the lapse; that needs a simulation-level API.

env-core: the chamber at 41 mm depth reaches 22 C on summer day 3 but about 8-14 C from summer day 4 night into autumn day 1. With the GDD start of summer day 3 the 4.5-5.5 GD lapse runs into autumn, and pupae stall below about 12 C. GDD 06 calibrates with a 19.5 C chamber.

colony-core: the minim rule should skip a colony whose queen still has founding reserves (founding currently resets core.minimSinceTick on each care tick). canLay should also respect the founding clutch cap by chamber volume.

actions: a 'readiness' refusal reason for seal-entrance (check E17). Also, in the browser, held actions started through __game.act repeat until stopped with phase 'stop'; seal-entrance from the throat with a pellet did not complete a seal in 12 scripted tries.
beh-nest: the reopen plan created by hand-over (a reopenEntrance command per sealed entrance of the cell) was not dug by the 4 nanitics within 20,000 ticks.
views: no camera aimed at the brood pile in the cell for a released queen (the time-lapse camera is still the possession boom).

worldgen-life: adopt the shared scoring functions (siteQuality, siteWordOf, factor rules) for the static map so overlay and read-out agree; the per-seed spread of cover kinds dominates the word distribution.
notesForIntegrator: Precedence calls recorded. (1) Directions §K over GDD 06 §5.7: cover litter 0.5, grass 0.15, word thresholds 0.68 / 0.74 / 0.89 (GDD said 0.30 / 0.55 / 0.75). The E16 Q values are unchanged; its words for lawn and paving sand differ. (2) GDD 06 model over GDD 02 brood mortality during founding: the founding hazard adds only what mu exceeds the colony's own base hazard by, averaged over development, so the total over development equals the model's.
Running Game.ts, App.tsx, colony/index.ts and balance/index.ts edits were small and additive; others were editing Game.ts at the same time (title host, edge glyph).

findings.title: Real environment: the default opening produces 0-1 first workers and the time-lapse runs into winter (AC3 and E18/E19 fail in the actual game)
findings.where: src/sim/colony/founding/outcome.verify.test.ts; the lapse in src/sim/colony/founding/care.ts and lapse.ts; cell temperature from the environment
findings.detail:
Every founding outcome test pins the temperature (19.5-30 C). With nothing pinned (makeTestSim seed 1, default Lasius start summer day 3, cheat.completeFounding):
- The founding cell at about 11 BU swings 10-25 C over each day and averages about 17 C.
- The pupae form at 2.75 GD, then stall as autumn cools the cell (8-11 C by autumn day 4-7). They die off one by one and none ecloses.
- At 14.25 GD the brood-lost rule sends the opening back to `lay` (0 workers).

In the browser (seed 1, run 1 above) the hand-over came on Spring Day 6 of Year 2, about 23 GD after the clutch. The outcome card read 'First workers: 1, Queen's reserves: 33 %', against a forecast of 12-22.

The GDD expects a span of 4.5-5.5 GD and 8-16 nanitics (§5.11, §5.15). The implementer's e2e hid this by setting the clock back to summer day 1. The fix may belong in environment or balance (start date, cell depth or thermal column), but the founding module must prove its outcome in the running game.

Repro: npx vitest run src/sim/colony/founding/outcome.verify.test.ts (fails: still in timelapse after 7 GD).

findings.title: Hand-over: the first workers never reopen the plugged entrance; the colony stays sealed in
findings.where: src/sim/colony/founding/handover.ts:58 (reopenEntrance request); root cause in src/sim/nest/plans/plans.ts:77 createEntrancePlan
findings.detail:
Repro: npx vitest run src/sim/colony/founding/handover.verify.test.ts (fails).
- The Node test builds a real plug with seal-entrance, lays 18 eggs with lay-egg and runs the lapse at 28 C. 13-17 workers exist at hand-over.
- After 3.3 GD the entrance is still 'sealed'. The reopen plan is 'active' with two slot ants, both in 'dig' with nav 'moving' indefinitely.
- Root cause: the plan's slot is placed at e.pos - e.dir*(radius+1 BU). The entrance dir is vertical (0,1,0), so for a sloped throat the slot lies inside solid soil, out of the ants' reach.
- In the browser, the possessed worker shows 'Forage · waiting to leave · deficit' (run 1, screenshot r05).

This breaks GDD 06 §5.13 (b), AC2 ('first workers at the reopened entrance') and AC6 (autonomous normal play). The e2e logs the failure but still returns ok:true. The nest module owns plans.ts, but the hand-over is a founding deliverable: it needs a founding-side rule (for example, the first nanitic runs unseal-entrance) or the fix requested from nest.

findings.title: Sealing as GDD 06 §5.9 describes it is impossible: holding E (seal-entrance) at the shaft is refused 'no-target'
findings.where: src/sim/colony/founding/dig.ts sealTick, flowView.ts prompts ('Seal the entrance'); action check in src/sim/ants/actions/defs/dig.ts:184
findings.detail:
seal-entrance needs a carried soil pellet. During the founding dig, autoHaul expels every pellet onto the mound (nest/bite.ts:165), so the queen reaches `seal` empty-handed.

Repro: in rules.verify.test.ts, the queen walks to 1.5 BU below the mouth and presses seal-entrance 4 times. All four are refused 'seal-entrance:no-target' and the phase stays `seal`.

It only works if the player first bites a wall for a pellet, which no prompt says (the passing regression test shows that one plug then seals). The spec asks for missing founding rules to be built in the founding folder. Instead the e2e used a cheat.fillSphere stand-in, and system.test also seals only with the cheat fill.

findings.title: Passive player soft-lock: after the automatic batch the time-lapse never starts
findings.detail:
In GDD 06 §5.1, the `lay` exit includes '1.5 GD after sealing with the automatic batch of 5.10 -> timelapse'.

In the code, the queen does lay her 6 eggs at 1.5 GD, but layTick returns true only when laid >= clutchLimit (40-48). So the opening stays in `lay` indefinitely: the opening's speed limits (pause, 1x, 2x) stay on and there is no hand-over.

Repro: rules.verify.test.ts 'the passive player' fails (expected 'timelapse', received 'lay' 600 ticks after the batch). The implementer's own passive test only checks that 6 eggs exist.

findings.title: Live site read-out and static suitability map use different factors, weights and thresholds (spec Boundary violated)
findings.where: src/sim/colony/founding/siteScore.ts, src/sim/balance/founding.ts SITE_WORD_Q / SITE_PROFILES vs src/worldgen/maps/suitability.ts + src/worldgen/tuning/maps.ts SUIT
findings.detail:
The task says: 'The live assessment must call the same factor functions and thresholds as the static suitability map (import them; do not re-implement), so the overlay and the read-out always agree.'

The module instead re-implements its own:
- A geometric mean with thresholds 0.68 / 0.74 / 0.89. The map uses a weighted sum with 0.72 / 0.86 / 0.93.
- Different moisture windows (Lasius 0.10/0.35/0.65/0.95 vs 0.10/0.30/0.55/0.85).
- Different weights.
- Different cover values (bare 0.1 vs 0.05; no 'beside' 0.8 level).

Repro: rules.verify.test.ts, first test. siteWordOf(q) and siteClass(q) disagree at 20 of 101 Q values (for example 0.68: fair vs poor). The implementer admits this in notDone.

findings.title: lay-egg is accepted in phase `seal`, before the entrance is sealed (GDD 06 §5.10)
findings.where: src/sim/colony/queen.ts:25 FOUNDING_LAY_PHASES includes 'seal' (colony-core file); founding owns the rule
findings.detail:
Repro: rules.verify.test.ts 'lay-egg is refused until the entrance is sealed' fails: eggsLaid becomes 1 in phase `seal`.

E is the key both for sealing at the shaft and for laying in the cell. A player pressing E in the chamber during `seal` lays single eggs into an open nest, and these count against the clutch. The founding module should refuse this through its own rule, or ask the colony owner to drop 'seal' from that set.

findings.title: Undo founding is accepted after eggs are laid; flow.retry() ignores the phase
findings.where: src/sim/colony/founding/commands.ts undo() (allowed phases include 'lay' unconditionally); src/game/flows/founding/flow.ts retry()
findings.detail:
GDD 06 §5.14 offers undo 'from the failure card or from the pause menu until the first lay'.

Repro: rules.verify.test.ts 'Undo founding is offered only until the first lay' fails. After a 6-egg batch, openingUndo is still not rejected. flow.retry() checks only retriesLeft, not the phase.

findings.title: Misleading colony alerts throughout the claustral founding
findings.detail:
During the lapse and the hand-over, the HUD shows the critical alert 'The colony is starving · brood is being sacrificed' (empty stores), 'Waste cannot leave the nest · no open entrance', and an empty red alert card.

In a claustral founding the queen feeds the brood from her reserves, so these are false alarms. The minim rule was suppressed for this case, but the starvation and waste alerts were not. Suppress them, or report them to the alert owners.

findings.title: Weak or tautological tests and a permissive e2e
findings.detail:
- flow.test's 'normal play' check calls allowedSpeeds() with a hand-written context (openingPhase null, timelapse false), so it can never fail.
- Every outcome test pins the temperature, which is why the real-environment outcome (blocker above) went unnoticed.
- system.test reaches `lay` only through cheat.fillSphere.
- The e2e returns ok:true with two stand-ins (cheat fill and teleport) and a plug that was never reopened. AC2 is therefore not actually checked.

findings.title: Time-lapse stage strip highlights the beat by playback fraction, not the brood's real stage
findings.detail: In run 1 screenshot r02, 'LARVAE' is highlighted while the strip shows 22 eggs and 0 larvae (p 0.17). This happens because the span estimate is far off (see the blocker above). The strip should follow the dominant real stage, or the counters.

findings.title: Tunable numbers inline in sim code

findings.detail: The seed requires all tunables to live in src/sim/balance or species data.

findings.title: Extra clutch after total brood loss uses a fixed eggsLaid offset
findings.detail: eggsLaid is set to cap - half (24), whatever the first clutch was (for example 6). The UI then reads 'Eggs 24 of 48' and the lapse 'Brood lost' counter (laid - live - eclosed) is inflated. clutchLimit also applies the chamber-volume cap (40 for a 10 BU³ cell), so the 'half the cap' extra clutch is 16 eggs, not 24. When the lapse is empty with completeFounding's autoClutch 24, the clutch counts as full straight away and the lapse restarts with no eggs.
